::: {#exm-bootstrap-normal-toy}
#### Normal bootstrap interval for the mean of ten glucose values

Continuing @exm-bootstrap-distribution-toy,
the 95% interval of @def-bootstrap-ci-normal is:

```{r}
#| code-fold: false
mean(glucose10) +
  c(lower = -1, upper = 1) * qnorm(0.975) * sd(boot_means10)
```

:::
